name: launcher_app_instance

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-10-3.1.28 image: launcher_page_insert_icon (0xc29b21c) returns early with 'launcher UI not created' while this global is null, and launcher_page_more_update_layout (0xc29b070) stores the launcher page view here.

notes: Null until the launcher page has been built once. insert_icon reports the log call's result even when it bails out, so this pointer is the only honest signal that the launcher tile can be inserted.
